title: Bitwise NAND
statement: Create an 8-bit bitwise NAND operator. The output should be the bitwise NAND of the two 8-bit inputs. This module is useful for building logic functions and implementing complex logic gates.
module_signature: module bitwise_nand(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output [7:0] y);
behavior: y is the bitwise NAND of a and b.
The result is 1 for each bit pair that is not both 1.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use registers or sequential constructs.
hint: Use bitwise operators directly for the NAND operation.
